rationale: The v5 SIMPLE-NN committee was ADOPTED (coordination_log.csv, 2026-07-16) as the first re-distillation to beat the original student, but with the explicit caveat that the 11 AL cells may overlap v5 training (error(c) partly in-distribution) and that clustered cells remain hardest with u_max>0.30 at x>=0.12. Held-out DFT evidence (heldout_baseline_errord.csv) further indicates the residual error at clustered defect cores is teacher-limited (teacher error(a)_core ~0.38 ~= v5 error(c)_core ~0.39 eV/A). This action deterministically aggregates the EXISTING held-out v5+teacher-vs-DFT per-cell errors into a leakage-checked, domain-tagged generalization verdict with teacher-vs-distillation attribution, to decide whether v5 is the production student and whether iteration-2 should fine-tune the teacher or re-distill. Read-only; no new compute.
